senses.gloss: (cmp. טחב) to be moist, soiled.—Part. pass. טָחוּף; fem. טְחוּפָה, pl. טְחוּפוֹת (of wool) dirty-white, gray, opp. לבנה bright-white.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 11:2">Ḥull. XI, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 136b">ib. 136ᵇ</cite> Ar. (ed. <he>שחופות</he>). [Cmp. Arab. ṭaḫf moeror, nubes.]
